reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  -- one row per order placed from April to June 2025 (UTC days of order_ts): its units, and 1 when any line had a discount
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS units, MAX(CASE WHEN line_discount_eur > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discounted
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00')
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(t.discounted) AS discounted_orders, SUM(t.units) AS units
FROM order_totals t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
GROUP BY o.channel

other_way.sql:
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.line_discount_eur > 0 THEN o.order_id END) AS discounted_orders, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
FROM orders o
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY o.channel
other_way.tradeoff: Joining first works with two DISTINCT counts, but it is easy to count discounted lines instead of discounted orders.

solver.query:
WITH ou AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.channel, COALESCE(SUM(l.quantity), 0) AS units,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN l.line_discount_eur > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disc
  FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(disc) AS discounted_orders, SUM(units) AS units
FROM ou GROUP BY channel
